summary: Practise mental toughness, cognitive reframing and team resilience planning. Explore the five-day course and build practical leadership routines.
lede: Emotionally resilient leader training gives team leaders, people managers and emerging supervisors practical ways to respond to work pressure while supporting team wellbeing. Participants use the 4Cs model, PERMA and ABC cognitive reframing to identify pressure points, reframe difficult situations and plan recovery. They also map team demands and resources, practise workload check-ins and develop a team resilience action plan.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who lead teams or coordinate work and need practical methods for responding to pressure without losing sight of team wellbeing. It also suits specialists whose responsibilities regularly require them to support leaders and team resilience.
prerequisites: No specialist resilience or psychology background is required. You should bring experience working in or alongside a team; exercises use workplace scenarios and do not require coding or specialist software.
